All tasks complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

## Trace Harness: crossbeam-deque

### Files Created

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `harness/src/tla_trace.rs` | Per-thread timebox trace module (rdtsc timestamps, thread-local writers) |
| `harness/src/trace_tests.rs` | 4 test scenarios (LIFO pop, FIFO pop, single steal, concurrent steal) |
| `harness/src/preprocess_trace.py` | Merges per-thread NDJSON files, compresses timestamps to dense integers |
| `harness/patches/instrumentation.patch` | Instruments `deque.rs` + `lib.rs` (261 lines) |
| `harness/apply.sh` | Copies trace module + applies patch to artifact |
| `harness/run.sh` | One-command: apply, build, run tests, preprocess, verify |
| `harness/INSTRUMENTATION.md` | Guide for Phase 3 agent |

### Spec Fix
- `Trace.tla`: Changed `TraceThreads == DOMAIN traces` to `DOMAIN traces \ {"flavor"}` to exclude metadata key
- `Trace.cfg`: Changed `Stealer = {s1, s2}` to `Stealer = {"s1", "s2"}` (strings match JSON thread IDs)

### Instrumented Events
Push, ResizeGrow, LIFOPop, FIFOPopAttempt, FIFOPopRollback, StealBegin, StealReadTask, StealCommit

### Trace Validation Results

| Trace | Events | TLC States | Result |
|-------|--------|-----------|--------|
| push_lifo_pop | 10 (Push x5, LIFOPop x5) | 12 | PASS |
| push_fifo_pop | 10 (Push x5, FIFOPopAttempt x5) | 12 | PASS |
| steal_single | 20 (Push x5, Steal x5) | 22 | PASS |
| concurrent_fifo | 24 (Push x8, Pop x8, 2 stealers) | 810 | PASS |

All 4 traces validated against `Trace.tla` with 3 invariants (ConsumedWasPushed, NoDoublePop, CurrentBufferAlive). The concurrent trace required 810 states due to timebox branching — demonstrating the Category B partial-order search working correctly.
